rules.title: Android reports a battery health problem
rules.interpretation: The OEM battery service reported a non-good health state.
rules.confidence_basis: Public Android API observation evaluated by policy v1
possible_explanations: Operating conditions, platform reporting, or a condition needing inspection
rules.further_inspection: Review battery service evidence and inspect the battery safely.
rules.limitations: OEM-reported status does not measure remaining capacity.

rules.title: Battery temperature needs attention
rules.interpretation: Battery temperature reached the advisory 45 C threshold during ordinary operation.
rules.confidence_basis: Public Android API observation evaluated by policy v1
possible_explanations: Operating conditions, platform reporting, or a condition needing inspection
rules.further_inspection: Pause inspection, allow cooling and repeat under normal conditions.
rules.limitations: A single reading cannot identify a battery defect.

rules.title: Charging observations disagree
rules.interpretation: Android reported charging while no power source was reported.
rules.confidence_basis: Public Android API observation evaluated by policy v1
possible_explanations: Operating conditions, platform reporting, or a condition needing inspection
rules.further_inspection: Repeat after checking cable and charger.
rules.limitations: Broadcast and fuel-gauge updates may arrive at different times.

rules.title: Battery counters need review
rules.interpretation: Remaining charge was reported as zero while battery level was nonzero.
rules.confidence_basis: Public Android API observation evaluated by policy v1
possible_explanations: Operating conditions, platform reporting, or a condition needing inspection
rules.limitations: Unsupported or faulty fuel-gauge reporting can explain this observation.

rules.title: Android reports thermal throttling
rules.interpretation: Android reports severe or greater thermal pressure.
rules.confidence_basis: Public Android API observation evaluated by policy v1
possible_explanations: Operating conditions, platform reporting, or a condition needing inspection
rules.further_inspection: Pause workloads and repeat after cooling.
rules.limitations: This reports system thermal policy, not CPU temperature.

rules.title: Security patch is over one year old
rules.interpretation: The reported patch date is at least 365 days before the observation date.
rules.confidence_basis: Public Android API observation evaluated by policy v1
possible_explanations: Operating conditions, platform reporting, or a condition needing inspection
rules.further_inspection: Check vendor updates before use with sensitive accounts.
rules.limitations: Advisory maintenance threshold. Patch metadata does not prove firmware authenticity.

rules.title: Security patch date is in the future
rules.interpretation: The device clock and security patch date disagree.
rules.confidence_basis: Public Android API observation evaluated by policy v1
possible_explanations: Operating conditions, platform reporting, or a condition needing inspection
rules.further_inspection: Check device date and vendor build information.
rules.limitations: Clock or vendor metadata can explain the discrepancy.

rules.title: Visible root-risk indicator
rules.interpretation: A conventional su path was visible.
rules.confidence_basis: Public Android API observation evaluated by policy v1
possible_explanations: Operating conditions, platform reporting, or a condition needing inspection
rules.further_inspection: Review device history and authorized vendor software.
rules.limitations: Heuristic indicator. Does not prove root, malware, or bootloader state.

rules.title: Firmware uses test-key build tags
rules.confidence_basis: Public Android API observation evaluated by policy v1
possible_explanations: Operating conditions, platform reporting, or a condition needing inspection
rules.further_inspection: Review vendor firmware and device history.
rules.limitations: Build tags alone cannot establish authenticity or malicious modification.

rules.title: Secure screen lock is unavailable
rules.interpretation: Android reports no secure device screen lock.
rules.confidence_basis: Public Android API observation evaluated by policy v1
possible_explanations: Operating conditions, platform reporting, or a condition needing inspection
rules.further_inspection: Configure a secure screen lock if this phone will hold private data.
rules.limitations: Setting observation, not a hardware failure.

rules.title: Developer options are enabled
rules.confidence_basis: Public Android API observation evaluated by policy v1
possible_explanations: Operating conditions, platform reporting, or a condition needing inspection
rules.further_inspection: Review debugging settings before handing over the phone.
rules.limitations: Legitimate developer settings are not evidence of malicious activity.

rules.title: Device attestation is unavailable
rules.interpretation: No configured Play Integrity service was available.
rules.confidence_basis: Public Android API observation evaluated by policy v1
possible_explanations: Operating conditions, platform reporting, or a condition needing inspection
rules.further_inspection: Use a legitimately configured integrity service if attestation is required.
rules.limitations: Verified Boot feature presence alone is not boot-chain verification.

rules.title: Android reports low memory
rules.confidence_basis: Public Android API observation evaluated by policy v1
possible_explanations: Operating conditions, platform reporting, or a condition needing inspection
rules.limitations: Memory pressure does not establish RAM-chip damage.

rules.title: App-private storage is nearly full
rules.interpretation: Less than 64 MiB is available to the application.
rules.confidence_basis: Public Android API observation evaluated by policy v1
possible_explanations: Operating conditions, platform reporting, or a condition needing inspection
rules.further_inspection: Free storage and repeat I/O checks.
rules.limitations: Advisory free-space threshold, not a NAND wear estimate.

rules.title: Computation timing varies
rules.interpretation: The slowest bounded computation window took at least twice the fastest.
rules.confidence_basis: Public Android API observation evaluated by policy v1
possible_explanations: Operating conditions, platform reporting, or a condition needing inspection
rules.limitations: Scheduling, thermal policy and background work affect timing. No processor degradation claim.

rules.title: Repeated computation completed
rules.interpretation: Three bounded computation windows completed and their output agreed.
rules.confidence_basis: Public Android API observation evaluated by policy v1
possible_explanations: Operating conditions, platform reporting, or a condition needing inspection
rules.further_inspection: Compare only repeated observations under similar conditions.

rules.title: Network has no validated internet
rules.interpretation: Android has not validated the current network.
rules.confidence_basis: Public Android API observation evaluated by policy v1
possible_explanations: Operating conditions, platform reporting, or a condition needing inspection
rules.further_inspection: Check router, captive portal and coverage.
rules.limitations: External service availability does not establish radio hardware failure.
